notes.title: MMA Executive V1.1
notes.content:
[b][u]MMA Executive V1.1[/u][/b]

Since the release of MMA Executive (V1.0) it has received various updates, most notably:

• A new Easy mode.
• A new "Advanced Analysis Report" system
• Adjustments to fight predictions system.
• Extensions to 2 instructional animations.
• An additional "STATS" column in "Staff Management".
• Minimizing the interface pauses fights.
• Fixed coaches "Overworked" calculation.

[u][b]Latest changes:[/b][/u]

• Fixed a bug where certain fighter names were too long in Gameplans causing the interface to hang in rare cases.
• Fixed Gameplan on screen distribution.

---------------------

Following these changes, Vectormatrix Limited has symbolically upgraded the version number from V1.0 to V1.1. This will not affect your saves.

Again, many thanks for all the feedback in the discussion boards, it has been invaluable to bringing you the best experience possible.
